about: The Workbench icons of the OpenSupaplex drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/opensupaplex.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/opensupaplex.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. The badge is the game's own icon art (amiga/icon/opensupaplex.png); the game's tool icon stays amiga/icon/opensupaplex.info (installed as OpenSupaplex.info). OpenSupaplex-drawer.info goes beside the drawer as OpenSupaplex.info.
